title: Base ROI
universe_prices_hint: Log in to price with your own CX preferences.
cogc_note: All rows assume the COGC and experts set here; recipe rows run on a standard planet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.visit_days_hint: The ship carries this many days of cargo per trip, in and out; rows that need more are hidden.
settings.show_unbuildable: Show planets without workers or plots

setup.title: Set up Base ROI
setup.intro: A few questions so the table fits how you play. You can change everything later in Settings.
setup.preset: How strict should the table be?
setup.rookie_text: Starter ship SCB (500 t / 500 m³), market capacity ≥ 0.7, 10-day buffer
setup.standard_text: WCB (3000 t / 1000 m³), market capacity ≥ 0.7, 10-day buffer
setup.veteran_text: Your choice of ship or no logistics limit, any market capacity, 10-day buffer

table.label: Base ROI table
table.search: Filter by Industry, Building, or Material…
table.population_failed: Population could not be loaded, so planets are not checked for workers.
table.history_failed: The price history could not be loaded.
table.history_none: No price history: ASK, BID and fixed prices

trend.title_building: Daily profit of the buildings in {focus}
trend.title_product: Daily profit of the materials of {focus}
trend.title_recipe: Daily profit of the recipes for {focus}
trend.note: Volume-weighted: each base counts by its material's 7-day traded volume; planet rows of one recipe count once, as the mean of their best 3 planets. Search an industry, building or material to drill in.
trend.empty: No rows with traded volume to chart.

tooltips.product: The material the base makes; resource and farming rows name the planet and its jumps to the exchange
tooltips.daily_profit: What the base earns per day after inputs, consumables, degradation and production fees
tooltips.break_even: Days until the base has paid back its building cost
tooltips.weekly_return: A week's profit as a share of the building cost
tooltips.building_cost: Construction, the stock buffer to start with and the HQ upgrade, if set
tooltips.running_cost: Inputs, consumables, degradation and production fees per day
tooltips.cargo: The larger of cargo in and cargo out per day, by weight and volume
tooltips.market_capacity: How many bases like this the market can take: traded per day ÷ the base's amount per day, the lowest of its outputs (O) and recipe inputs (I)
tooltips.plots: Free plots of the planet. Full without ghost sites means no new base fits, so the row is hidden unless you show planets without workers or plots.
tooltips.workforce: Workers the base needs per tier
tooltips.history: Daily profit with the daily VWAP of each material's exchange, last 30 days

math.stage: {n} expert: {days} at {profit} per day | {n} experts: {days} at {profit} per day
math.stage_rest: {n} expert: then {profit} per day | {n} experts: then {profit} per day
math.cargo_ship: {days} days: {weight} t · {volume} m³ of {ship} {capWeight} t · {capVolume} m³
math.capacity_out: {ticker} (O): {traded} traded ÷ {amount} produced = {value}, one base is {share} of the market
math.capacity_in: {ticker} (I): {traded} traded ÷ {amount} needed = {value}, one base is {share} of the market
